source: ASCII (ANSI X3.4) with 128 added to each byte
version: ANSI X3.4-1986
scope: ASCII in bytes 128 to 255, as Prime computers kept text, with 0x8D and 0x8A as carriage return and line feed. A byte below 128 is shown as itself.
model: none
keep_bytes: false
cr_lf: 8D 8A
